content: <thought>The target 4,4'-dimethoxystilbene can be assembled in a single step by a McMurry coupling of two equivalents of commercially available p‑anisaldehyde (4‑methoxybenzaldehyde). This reaction breaks the aldehyde functional groups and forms a C‑C double bond, giving the desired alkene directly. p‑Anisaldehyde is inexpensive (well under $150 for the required amount). I will construct the retrosynthesis JSON: the root molecule is the target, its child is a reaction (McMurry coupling) with a suitable template ID (e.g., 12345 as a placeholder for a McMurry‑type carbonyl coupling). The precursors are two molecules of p‑anisaldehyde (SMILES: COc1ccc(C=O)cc1).
